segments.sn24.6:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.6:1.3: ‘karoto kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācāpayato socato socāpayato kilamato kilamāpayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
segments.sn24.6:1.4: Khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā pathaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
segments.sn24.6:1.5: Dakkhiṇaṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya; hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
segments.sn24.6:1.6: Uttaraṃ cepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya; dadanto dāpento yajanto yajāpento, natthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
segments.sn24.6:1.7: Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’”ti.
segments.sn24.6:1.8: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.6:2.2: ‘karoto kārayato … pe … natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’ti.
segments.sn24.6:2.4: Vedanāya sati … pe … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.6:2.8: ‘karoto kārayato … pe … natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’”ti.
segments.sn24.6:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.6:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.6:3.5: ‘karoto … pe … natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo”ti?
segments.sn24.6:3.8: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.6:3.12: “Aniccaṃ, bhante … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.6:3.14: ‘karoto kārayato … pe … natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’”ti?
segments.sn24.6:3.17: “Yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.6:3.18: “Aniccaṃ, bhante … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.6:3.20: ‘karoto kārayato … pe … natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’”ti?
segments.sn24.6:4.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu ca ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

lines: Socato socāpayatoti parassa bhaṇḍaharaṇādīhi sokaṃ sayaṃ karontassāpi parehi kārentassāpi.
Kilamato kilamāpayatoti āhārupacchedabandhanāgārapavesanādīhi sayaṃ kilamentassapi parehi kilamāpentassapi.
Phandato phandāpayatoti paraṃ phandantaṃ phandanakāle sayampi phandato parempi phandāpayato.
Karoto na karīyati pāpanti yaṃkiñci pāpaṃ karomīti saññāya karotopi pāpaṃ na karīyati, natthi pāpaṃ.
Sattā pana karomāti evaṃsaññino hontīti dīpenti.
Dakkhiṇanti dakkhiṇatīre manussā kakkhaḷā dāruṇā, te sandhāya hanantotiādi vuttaṃ.
Uttaranti uttaratīre saddhā honti pasannā buddhamāmakā dhammamāmakā saṅghamāmakā, te sandhāya dadantotiādi vuttaṃ.
Papañcasūdaniyaṃ “tajjentassa cā”ti attho vutto, idha pana sumaṅgalavilāsiniyaṃ viya tajjanaṃ paribhāsanaṃ daṇḍeneva saṅgahetvā “daṇḍena pīḷentassa” icceva vuttaṃ.
Sokaṃ sayaṃ karontassāti parassa sokakāraṇaṃ sayaṃ karontassa, sokaṃ vā uppādentassa.
Atipātayatoti padaṃ suddhakattuatthe hetukattuatthe ca vattatīti āha –
Gharassa bhitti anto ca bahi ca sandhitā hutvā ṭhitāva gharasandhi.
Pāpaṃ na karīyati pubbe asato uppādetuṃ asakkuṇeyyattā, tasmā natthi pāpaṃ.

Yadi evaṃ kathaṃ sattā pāpe pavattantīti āha “sattā pana karomāti evaṃsaññino hontī”ti evaṃ kirassa hoti imesañhi sattānaṃ hiṃsādikiriyā na attānaṃ phusati tassa niccatāya nibbikārattā, sarīraṃ pana acetanaṃ kaṭṭhakaliṅgarūpamaṃ, tasmiṃ vikopitepi na kiñci pāpanti.
